description: This file defines the Number class in the SCSSPHP project, representing numeric values with optional units, including methods for unit conversion, comparison, and serialization.

classes.name: Number
classes.description: Represents a numeric value with optional units, supporting operations like comparison, conversion, and serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Number instance with a dimension and optional numerator and denominator units.

methods.name: getDimension
methods.description: Returns the numeric dimension of the number.

methods.name: getNumeratorUnits
methods.description: Returns the list of numerator units.

methods.name: getDenominatorUnits
methods.description: Returns the list of denominator units.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the Number object for JSON output, supporting full units.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific offset exists in the object.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves a value at a specific offset.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Throws exception; Number is immutable.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Throws exception; Number is immutable.

methods.name: unitless
methods.description: Returns true if the number has no units.

methods.name: hasUnits
methods.description: Returns true if the number has any units.

methods.name: hasUnit
methods.description: Checks whether the number has exactly the specified unit.

methods.name: unitStr
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the number's units.

methods.name: valueInRange
methods.description: Checks if the number's value is within a specified range.

methods.name: valueInRangeWithUnit
methods.description: Checks if the number's value is within a range with a specific unit.

methods.name: assertNoUnits
methods.description: Asserts that the number has no units.

methods.name: assertUnit
methods.description: Asserts that the number has a specific unit.

methods.name: assertSameUnitOrUnitless
methods.description: Asserts that the number has the same units or is unitless as another number.

methods.name: coerce
methods.description: Returns a copy of the number coerced to specified units.

methods.name: isComparableTo
methods.description: Checks if the number is comparable to another number.

methods.name: lessThan
methods.description: Checks if the number is less than another number.

methods.name: lessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if the number is less than or equal to another number.

methods.name: greaterThan
methods.description: Checks if the number is greater than another number.

methods.name: greaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if the number is greater than or equal to another number.

methods.name: plus
methods.description: Returns the sum of this number and another.

methods.name: minus
methods.description: Returns the difference between this number and another.

methods.name: unaryMinus
methods.description: Returns the negation of the number.

methods.name: modulo
methods.description: Returns the modulo of this number by another.

methods.name: times
methods.description: Multiplies this number by another.

methods.name: dividedBy
methods.description: Divides this number by another.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this number is equal to another.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the number, supporting full units.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the number.

methods.name: coerceNumber
methods.description: Helper for coercing two numbers to the same units for operations.

methods.name: coerceUnits
methods.description: Helper for coercing units for comparison and arithmetic.

methods.name: valueInUnits
methods.description: Converts the number to specified units, throwing if incompatible.

methods.name: multiplyUnits
methods.description: Multiplies units and values, returning a new Number.

methods.name: getConversionFactor
methods.description: Returns the conversion factor between two units if available.

methods.name: getUnitString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of units.
